name: Roasted Pepper Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, halved and deseeded
Lemon juice, salt and black pepper
steps: Roast the peppers at 220°C for 20 minutes, or char them over a flame, until blistered. Cover for 5 minutes and peel off the skins.
Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Add the paprika.
Add the peppers, three-quarters of the chickpeas and the stock; simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the remaining chickpeas.
Season with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
note: Roasting the peppers gives a smoky sweetness without any added sugar or cream.
